provenance: Actual installed G1 firmware executed through a disposable local profile; no physical calculator accessed. Numeric ASC readback preserves isolated UTF-16 units without relying on invalid Unicode text decoding.

cases.name: units
cases.source: EXPORT STRUNITS() BEGIN LOCAL s:=CHAR({65,55357,56832,66}); RETURN {DIM(s),SIZE(s),ASC(s),ASC(LEFT(s,2)),ASC(RIGHT(s,2)),ASC(MID(s,2,1)),INSTRING(s,CHAR(56832)),ASC(REPLACE(s,2,CHAR(88))),ASC(ROTATE(s,1))}; END;

cases.name: charbounds
cases.source: EXPORT CHARBOUND() BEGIN LOCAL r:={},s; IFERR s:=CHAR(65536); r:=CONCAT(r,{ASC(s)}); THEN r:=CONCAT(r,{"error65536"}); END; IFERR s:=CHAR(-1); r:=CONCAT(r,{ASC(s)}); THEN r:=CONCAT(r,{"errorminus"}); END; IFERR s:=CHAR(128512); r:=CONCAT(r,{ASC(s)}); THEN r:=CONCAT(r,{"errorastral"}); END; RETURN r; END;

cases.name: nul
cases.source: EXPORT NULSTR() BEGIN LOCAL s:=CHAR({65,0,66}); RETURN {DIM(s),SIZE(s),ASC(s),ASC(s+CHAR(67)),ASC(LEFT(s,3))}; END;

cases.name: index
cases.source: EXPORT INDEXSTR() BEGIN LOCAL s:=CHAR({65,55357,56832,66}); RETURN {ASC(s(2)),ASC(s(3)),ASC(LEFT(s,2)+RIGHT(s,2))}; END;

cases.name: case
cases.source: EXPORT CASESTR() BEGIN LOCAL s:=CHAR({97,55357,98}); RETURN {ASC(UPPER(s)),ASC(LOWER(UPPER(s)))}; END;
